items.name: fp32.exp_a_gray_walk
items.rule: A[i][k] = (1 + m_k) * 2^(gray(i) - 15), positive, one random mantissa per column k and the exponent field 0x70 with its low four bits a Gray code down the rows: each step down an A column flips exactly one exponent bit, the value jumping 2x, 4x, 16x or 256x; B every line the same, eight random normal words per lane and columns l and l+8 equal, so B never changes
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy fp32: half or more of the operand flips in the exponent field (critic rank 1: +0.17-0.20 W over every model in pool 6)

items.name: fp32.exp_b_alt_b26

items.open_case: E exponent-heavy fp32: half or more of the operand flips in the exponent field (critic rank 1: +0.17-0.20 W over every model in pool 6)

items.name: fp32.exp_b_alt_lsb
items.rule: A every element 1.25; B columns 0-7 random sign and mantissa, exponent field an even number in 118..136; column l+8 the same word with exponent bit 0 (word bit 23) set: each lane flips exactly one exponent bit a cycle (x / 2x), fresh words on every line
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy fp32: half or more of the operand flips in the exponent field (critic rank 1: +0.17-0.20 W over every model in pool 6)

items.name: fp32.exp_b_alt_nib
items.rule: as exp_b_alt_lsb with the exponent field in 112..143 and column l+8's field = column l's XOR 0x0F: four exponent bits (word bits 23-26) a cycle, the two words up to 2^15 apart
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy fp32: half or more of the operand flips in the exponent field (critic rank 1: +0.17-0.20 W over every model in pool 6)

items.name: fp32.exp_only_pos12
items.rule: both sides +2^U{-12..12}: sign 0 and mantissa 0, so only exponent bits move, every product an exact power of two (between pool 6's narrow 1/4..4 and pool 5's 2^-40..2^40, and positive)
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy fp32: half or more of the operand flips in the exponent field (critic rank 1: +0.17-0.20 W over every model in pool 6)
